title: Paperclip–OpenClaw Retry Policy
description: Per-error-code retry policy. Retry decisions are made by the client (OpenClaw Gateway), not the agent. Retryable=true alone does not trigger retry — idempotency key presence and operation type also gate retry.

RATE_LIMITED.notes: Honor Retry-After header on 429. Prefer waiting over blind backoff.

UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE.notes: 503 from Paperclip 4B. Only retry if idempotency key present.

TIMEOUT.notes: Client-side or proxy timeout. Only retry mutations with idempotency key.

SCHEMA_VALIDATION_FAILED.notes: Bad params — retrying will not fix validation errors.

POLICY_DENIED.notes: Forbidden operation — retrying will not change the policy decision.

APPROVAL_DENIED.notes: Operator denied — retry only with new approval.

IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.notes: Same key used with different payload — retrying will not resolve the conflict.

UNKNOWN_STATE.notes: Manual review required — automated retry is not safe.

UPSTREAM_FAILED.notes: Known failure mode — retrying may compound the problem.

retryGatingRules.description: All three conditions must be true to retry a retryable error
conditions: The error code's retryable field is true
A valid idempotencyKey is present in the request
The operation is either read-only OR the idempotency store confirmed no prior completion

backoffStrategy.description: Exponential backoff with jitter, capped at 10 seconds
backoffStrategy.jitterRange: 0–200ms added to base before exponential growth
